name: Benchmark
concept: The plain rules v15 fighter: two of each type, no card text, no Super. A fast Strike and a slow, bigger one; a quick Grab and a slow, harder Heavy; a Block and a Dodge.
notes: Added 30 Oct 2026. HP 22 sits in the middle of the ported fighters (21-23). In its own mirror (Hard vs Hard, any-attack follow-up, 1,000 games): median 15 rounds, quiet rounds 18%, Throw 29% and Block 26% of plays, Big Swing 11%, Slash 11%, Dodge 9%. A Pressure-only bot beats Hard 2% of the time; a random bot 41%.
